notes.title: itch.io launch and Steam keys for account ownership
notes.notes:
Hi y'all, I've had a few requests over the years for a way to bind [i]You Have to Win the Game[/i] to your account so it will still appear in your library when uninstalled. Steam doesn't normally support this for free games, but activating a key for the game will have this effect. (Low-cost zero-content DLC will apparently do the same, but I personally don't care for that option.) Unfortunately, this has meant handling these requests on a case-by-case basis in the past.

Today, I made [url=https://piratehearts.itch.io/you-have-to-win-the-game][i]You Have to Win the Game[/i][/url] available on itch.io. This is the first time the remixed campaign and cat mode have been released outside of Steam, and thanks to itch.io's flexible payment options, this also provides an automated way to extend Steam keys to those who want them.

[i]You Have to Win the Game[/i] is still free as always, but if you pay at least $1.00 on itch.io, you'll receive a Steam key that will bind the game to your account so it will still appear in your library when uninstalled.

This probably impacts a relative few of you, but if this was something that bothered you in the past, there is now an automated process for addressing it. :)

As an aside, you may encounter a "product was already owned" error when attempting to activate one of these keys due to the existing complimentary license. Here is an email I received detailing how to go about fixing that:

[quote]
A little breakdown of the steps I took though, it might help other people:

I tried activating product using the key you sent me; Steam gave the error that the "product was already owned." It was hinting at the YHtWtG entry marked as "Complimentary" in the "Licenses and product key activations" page of my account information, which was added to my account the first time I downloaded the game. Every free product marked as complimentary has a "Remove" button, and can easily be removed from the account. So I uninstalled the game and then removed its complimentary license entry. The game was now removed from my library (after uninstalling) and from my account completely.

After completely removing all traces of the game from both my computer and my account, I attempted a second time to activate the license using the key you provided. It worked this time; no error. Before even installing the game, it popped up in my library, indicating that, yep, it worked. But to be absolutely sure, I reinstalled the game, uninstalled it again, and the game did not disappear, ready for quick and easy re-installing (which, of course, I did :).

So... using the key most definitely does work. If anyone ever has a problem activating a key, it's most likely because of the complimentary license added to the account automatically when a user first downloads a game. Easy fix, the experiment was completed successfully (in all of two minutes). And again, thanks!
[/quote]

notes.title: Super Win the Game, coming to an event near you!
notes.notes:
[img=http://superwinthegame.com/img/swg.png]

Hey y'all, hope you've been enjoying You Have to WIn the Game! I've been working on the NES-themed sequel [url=www.superwinthegame.com]Super Win the Game[/url] since February, and I'm just about ready to show it off! I've been crunching hardcore for the last few weeks to get a demo build out the door, and I'm super excited about how it's looking.

[img=http://superwinthegame.com/img/SuperWinTheGame_1.jpg]

If you're in or around the North Dallas area, there are a few regional events coming up where you can check out a playable build of Super Win the Game. The first one is [url=https://www.eventbrite.com/e/indie-game-showcase-tickets-11620393911]this Saturday in Plano at Motus Digital[/url], and there will be more coming up in July and beyond. We'll be at [url=www.rtxevent.com]RTX[/url] in Austin and [url=www.sgconvention.com]SGC[/url], [url=www.quakecon.org]QuakeCon[/url], and [url=www.gamedallas.org]GameDallas[/url] in Dallas.

Check out the [url=www.superwinthegame.com/#events]calendar of upcoming events[/url] and stop by if you're able! We'll have an awesome playable demo and a bunch of swag to give away!

Hope to see y'all there!
